source_checkpoint.verification: local main, remote main, local annotated tag, peeled remote tag, public non-draft release, rendered pages, and release closure agreed

measured_weakness.summary: The released evidence-priority retriever ranks all project-classified telemetry and status ahead of guidance but ignores observation freshness. Five stale, query-matching telemetry records can consume the top-four window before the agent's one-hour freshness filter runs, removing the one current decision record.
measured_weakness.released_behavior: lexical scoring and project-evidence priority precede top-four truncation; stale filtering occurs only inside the downstream deterministic agent
measured_weakness.risk: Stale evidence can produce a safe denial of benign utility: the agent requests evidence instead of diagnosing or proposing the control action even when current evidence exists in the supplied corpus. Policy compliance remains intact, but the product promise of usefulness under stale evidence is not met.

held_out_discipline.rule: Freeze one test-split control-to-variant transformation and exact expectations before implementation; do not run or inspect its candidate result until the generic candidate and focused development checks are complete.

bounded_improvement.objective: Preserve fresh decision evidence under stale project-evidence flooding in development and untouched held-out splits without changing the agent's purpose, action set, executor, approval boundary, or runtime authority.
bounded_improvement.candidate_class: freshness-priority lexical retrieval that uses the existing one-hour evidence contract, ranks fresh externally classified telemetry/status ahead of stale project evidence and guidance, and retains all retrieved identities for audit
bounded_improvement.comparison: frozen evidence-priority-lexical-v2 pre-change control versus one generic standard-library candidate
separate_metrics: exact outcome, diagnosis, action, trajectory, incident status, and terminal state
retrieval, generation, policy, benign utility, attack success, repeated reliability, latency, and cost
non_goals: change evidence kinds or trust external content
change agent logic, action set, approval, executor, or infrastructure boundary
add a model, dependency, external service, or real operational data

retained_failures: The first inline development probe omitted PYTHONPATH=src and failed with ModuleNotFoundError before importing project code or changing state; the corrected read-only probe passed.
